field.label: Enable Client
field.help: Run the trusttunnel_client daemon on this OPNsense (requires an Active server).

field.label: Mode
field.help: Traffic policy: general tunnels all destinations except exclusions; selective tunnels only allowed destinations.

field.label: TUN interface name
field.help: Leave empty to allocate the next FreeBSD tun device, or use tun<number>. The plugin owns and removes devices it creates.

field.label: Allowed destinations
field.help: Managed OS routes in both modes (e.g. 198.51.100.0/24); in selective mode this list also selects tunneled destinations. Leave empty for external route management.

field.label: Excluded routes
field.help: Comma-separated CIDRs that must not be installed on the TUN interface.

field.label: Use existing TUN device
field.help: Attach to tun_interface instead of creating it. Leave disabled for normal OPNsense operation.

field.label: TUN MTU
field.help: FreeBSD tunnel MTU; 1350 is the upstream default.

field.label: Change system DNS
field.help: Unsupported on OPNsense. Keep disabled and manage DNS through OPNsense.

field.label: Outbound interface
field.help: Required physical interface used for the endpoint connection; verify the per-node WAN name before Apply.
